header.headline: Run your own {edition}.
header.lede: Don't want to wait for the morning delivery? Drive it yourself. Bring your own API key (optional), generate today's digest across every topic you've picked, then send it straight to your inbox. Every topic is open during the free testing period.

key.fallback: No key? No problem — generation falls back to Curio's own key.

generate.noTopics: You haven't picked any topics yet. Choose your beats first.

send.body: Emails the most recent digest you haven't sent yet. Generate one above first if you don't have an unsent edition waiting.
send.ready: ● An unsent digest is ready to send

errors.lostConnection: Lost connection to Studio — reload to refresh status
